name: Verify Carrillo Jira variant 77 Case Created Correctly
description: Check that a new High priority email case was created for Carrillo Inc and the correct installed Jira Variant 77 system

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND account_id = 19 AND contact_id = 31 AND product_id = 97 AND installed_product_id = 98 AND channel = 'email' AND priority = 'high' AND state = 'new';

name: Carrillo Jira variant 77 Case Knowledge Linkage
description: Verify that the Jira Variant 77 troubleshooting article is linked to the new case as a suggested solution

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 528 AND case_id = 1233 AND knowledge_id = 145 AND used_as = 'suggested';

name: Notification sent
description: Verify that a solution proposal email was sent to Patricia with the correct article and case context

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM notification WHERE notification_id = 734 AND case_id = 1233 AND knowledge_id = 145 AND email = 'patricia.castro@carrilloinc.com' AND type = 'solution_proposal' AND status = 'success';

name: Response SLA linked to case
description: Verify that response SLA is linked to case

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 1233 AND sla_def_id = 2 AND stage = 'in_progress';

name: Resolution SLA linked to case
description: Verify that resolution SLA is linked to case

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 1233 AND sla_def_id = 7 AND stage = 'in_progress';
